chapter_title: Concerning why Some shall delay to come forth from
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual Translation of
 Kephalaia 
¶2

The
 second state

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [sec]ond [matter is this:] if he shall fall [from wisdom into a lower degree,] one [condition shall change in] one hour [of that state; the] others who shall [not yet go forward] and they remain. They shall delay until they [perceive that] he is freed, and they delay to come toward [conjunction with him.]
